snippet.title: Infinity Blade PC - Download Now!
snippet.description:
~~~DOWNLOAD~~~ 

https://archive.org/details/infinity-blade-pc

This channel is a source of Infinity Blade news. I did not make the port, this is purely journalism. With that being said, we have made a fan-built discord server (linked below) you can join where we have discovered the PC Port and are doing things such as adding shaders, fixing bugs, and custom textures.  Portions of the materials used are trademarks and/or copyrighted works of Epic Games, Inc. All rights reserved by Epic. This material is not official and is not endorsed by Epic.

https://discord.gg/3SHzH2567c

Archive Disclaimer:
-  The source code for Infinity Blade I has been publically accessible in forums since 2014.
-  The game itself has been made impossible to purchase since 2018, and impossible to download since 2020, despite having purchased the title.
-  This port does NOT redistribute the source code. Instead, it packages the game in a way that's appropriate for PC distribution. In other words, there is little difference between what's accessible on the iOS and PC versions.
-  All efforts on this port have been done purely for the sake of lost media preservation. Credit belongs to the rightful authors; we take zero credit for this producing this work and gain nothing in return.

 

~~~TIMESTAMPS~~~
0:00 - Intro
0:52 - Features/Gameplay
5:11 - Developer Commands
7:54 - Backup Saves!

~~~TUTORIAL~~~

Here is the link to the download: https://archive.org/details/infinity-blade-pc

1. To install it just download the ZIP file and unzip it.

2. To launch the game open the Infinity Blade PC folder you downloaded then open the Binaries folder. Inside will be the laucher.exe. Double click that to launch the game.

3. The first time you open the game Windows Defender will pop up saying its an "unrecognized app". Just click "more info", then at the bottom select "Run Anyway". The file is completely safe.

4. (Optional) Make a desktop shortcut of that launcher.exe file for ease of access.
That's all, enjoy!

5. You can customize hotkeys, graphics, subtitles, and much more!

~~~DEVELOPER COMMANDS~~~
1) Inside of "Controls" under the launcher Options, assign "Console (Small)" to your TAB key. 
2) When in the main game, you can use a variety of commands to customize our experience. Here are a few:

⚔️ HudDrawDisable | HudDrawEnable - Turns HUD off/on

⚔️toggledebugcamera - FREE CAM!!!!! Nagivate using W A S D (move left, right, forward back), E Q (up, down), and the arrow keys (turn left, right)

⚔️ FOV F - type in any number for F, and that's you new FoV! default is 65/75.


Join the Infinity Blade Discord with over 18,000 members!!
https://discord.gg/QTmsQ3y
